notes: Reached ES storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session; store 84009900, catalog 80290093, languageId -5). Checked the full mega-menu tree (homepage serverApp-state), robots.txt (no Claude-named disallow), and the ES category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-es-0.xml.gz, 1670 URLs; full-text scanned for 'novedad'/'nuevo'/'arrival'/'recien llegad'/'coleccion nueva' substrings -- exactly one standalone hit). Found exactly one standalone New Arrivals-type page: the top-level nav item 'NOVEDADES' -> https://www.zarahome.com/es/novedades-coleccion-n942, confirmed present as its own entry in the ES sitemap (seoId 942 -- the exact same shared Inditex taxonomy node/categoryId already used for the identical concept on sibling stores GB (SR90, /gb/new-in-collection-n942) and DE (SR106, /de/neuheiten-kollektion-n942), confirming a shared taxonomy node populated with ES's own catalogue). A second internal menu entry also referencing 'NOVEDADES' (breadcrumb path NINOS Y BEBES > NOVEDADES, menuEntryId 1020377506) resolves only to the Kids department's own landing page as an in-page widget, the same non-genuine celement pattern documented on GB/DE for their Kids 'New In' entries -- it is not present as its own URL anywhere in the ES sitemap, so it was not emitted as its own row. Opened the genuine page (rendered <title> = 'Ultimas novedades | Zara Home Espana'; <meta description> = 'Descubre las ultimas novedades de la semana en Zara Home...' i.e. 'Discover the latest additions of the week at Zara Home' -- self-describing as newly-added products, not a themed campaign): confirmed it is a real, filterable product grid -- the underlying API response's own 'filters' object carries live facets (colFilter 14, catFilter 17, sizeFilter 118, priceFilter, discountFilter, noveltyFilter 14, etc.), not an editorial/lookbook page. Read the exact server-side API response the page itself calls: GET /itxrest/3/catalog/store/84009900/80290093/category/1020447643/product?showProducts=false&showNoStock=false&withSubCategories=false&languageId=-5&appId=1 -> productIds array length = 447. Independently cross-checked by summing unique ccId values across every rendered gridElements block (227 CMS blocks, all tagged grid_section_name='All Products', some blocks bundling multiple products into one visual tile): unique ccId count = 447, an exact match with zero discrepancy against the raw productIds array -- i.e. every product id is rendered exactly once as a grid tile. sortedProductIds (a narrower Product-kind-only subset) = 355, not used, consistent with the DE sibling's finding that the raw productIds/rendered-tile count is the reliable exact metric for this storefront (ES renders no plain 'N items' text header anywhere, matching GB/DE/UAE). Used 447 as qty. No genuine New Arrivals sub-structure exists as separate sitemap-listed URLs, so this is emitted as a single row.
